rationale: The default requests one retained-shell P:G'(D) traversal using the compiler-owned product rule without losing shell/component reuse. Admission requires one unscreened derivative item, the generated shell force lease and numerical audit storage. Missing admission preserves bounded symmetric two-pass polarization; canonical residency alone never selects the slower historical generic experiment. Explicit opt-out and legacy validation schedules remain available.
revisit_condition: Retain source-matched complete-endpoint, independent force/residual and real-device lifetime gates for changes to the shell schedule or its admission. Do not automatically promote the unchanged generic canonical traversal, whose retained historical endpoint regressed.
